email.body:
Hello,

Brightwater Pumps Ltd would like a quotation for the part below.

RFQ number: BWP-2026-0418
Part: FLG-5520 Rev A, blind flange adapter
Quantity: 120 pcs (split delivery 60 + 60 acceptable)
Material: 316L stainless, material certs 3.1 required
Required delivery: first 60 pcs by 15 January 2027
Please return your quote by 27 November 2026.

DXF drawing attached. We do not have a 3D model for this part.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman
Senior Buyer, Brightwater Pumps Ltd
+44 1632 960 418
